--- alter_queue_interleave.sql
ALTER QUEUE Q SET INTERLEAVE IN T

--- AST
&ast.AlterQueue{
  Name: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 12,
        NameEnd: 13,
        Name:    "Q",
      },
    },
  },
  QueueAlteration: &ast.SetInterleaveIn{
    Set:         14,
    OnDeleteEnd: -1,
    TableName:   &ast.Path{
      Idents: []*ast.Ident{
        &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 32,
          NameEnd: 33,
          Name:    "T",
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
ALTER QUEUE Q SET INTERLEAVE IN T
